context: A dad and his young son chat during a morning shower routine
purpose: Teach: カラオケ/シャワー/親父/外出/ねこ/飲ま/眠っ/つまらない

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 翔、もう起きたか？早くシャワーを浴びてこい。
lines.en: Sho, you up already? Hurry and go take a shower.
lines.style: Gentle morning dad voice, slightly groggy but warm and brisk.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うーん、まだ寝てたのに。お父さん、お湯熱すぎない？
lines.en: Mmm, but I was still asleep. Dad, isn't the water too hot?
lines.style: Sleepy whiny child voice, half-yawning and lightly complaining.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ちょうどいい温度だぞ。ほら、お茶も飲まないと喉カラカラになるからな。
lines.en: It's just the right temperature. Here, drink some tea or your throat will get bone-dry.
lines.style: Patient fatherly tone, brisk and caring morning instruction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえお父さん、うちのねこ、さっきまでぐっすり眠ってたよ。
lines.en: Hey Dad, our cat was sound asleep until just a moment ago.
lines.style: Excited child voice sharing a small discovery, bright cheerful tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そうか。今日は外出予定あるから、早く着替えなさい。
lines.en: Is that so. We have plans to go out today, so get dressed quickly.
lines.style: Busy parent voice nudging child along, mildly hurried but kind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えー、お買い物だけ？つまらないよー、行きたくない。
lines.en: Aww, just shopping? That's boring, I don't wanna go.
lines.style: Disappointed child pouting voice, dragging out vowels in protest.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 親父の言うこと聞け。夜はママと一緒にカラオケ行くぞ。
lines.en: Listen to your old man. Tonight we're going to karaoke with Mom.
lines.style: Teasing dad voice referring to himself, lifting mood with surprise reveal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やったー！カラオケ大好き！早くシャワー終わらせる！
lines.en: Yay! I love karaoke! I'll finish my shower fast!
lines.style: Burst of excited childlike energy, very enthusiastic happy shout.
